title: Probability of a specified output
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols, Boolean strings $x$ and $v$, and a natural number $t$, the output probability is the probability, under the length-$t$ random choice distribution, that running $N$ on $x$ with the random choice string produces exactly $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
caveat: The supplied statement uses a random-choice probability function whose distribution is not defined among the provided upstream definitions.
